title: Informal conjecture on the actual diameter
statement_text: Let $\Gamma\subset\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{R})$ be a co-compact arithmetic lattice of co-volume $V_\Gamma$ coming from the proper units of an Eichler order. The almost-diameter bound $\min_{\gamma\in\Gamma}d(\gamma z,w)\le(1+o(1))\log 3V_\Gamma$ (for every $w\in\mathbb{H}$ and almost every $z\in\Gamma\backslash\mathbb{H}$) is sharp, and one may speculate whether the actual diameter of the hyperbolic surface $\Gamma\backslash\mathbb{H}$ is around the same length, i.e. $(1+o(1))\log 3V_\Gamma$.
context_text: Here $\mathbb{H}$ is the hyperbolic upper half-plane with hyperbolic distance $d$, and $\Gamma$ is a co-compact arithmetic lattice of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{R})$ of co-volume $V_\Gamma$ stemming from the proper units of an Eichler order $R$ of level $Q$ in a quaternion algebra over $\mathbb{Q}$ of reduced discriminant $D$; the size of a matrix is measured by its Frobenius norm. The author proves that for almost every $w$, $\sup_{z\in\mathbb{H}}\min_{\gamma\in\Gamma}d(\gamma z,w)\le(2+o(1))\log 3V_\Gamma$, so the diameter of $\Gamma\backslash\mathbb{H}$ is at most $(2+o(1))\log 3V_\Gamma$; and, if $Q$ is square-free, or assuming Selberg's eigenvalue conjecture for $\Gamma_0(DQ)$ or a sup-norm conjecture for exceptional eigenforms, that for every $w$ almost every $z$ is within distance $(1+o(1))\log 3V_\Gamma$ of the orbit $\Gamma w$ (the almost diameter), which is sharp. Consequently such $\Gamma$ (for almost every embedding, and for every embedding under those conditions) is generated by its elements of Frobenius norm $O_\varepsilon(V_\Gamma^{2+\varepsilon})$. A diameter of $(1+o(1))\log 3V_\Gamma$ would imply generation by elements of norm $O_\varepsilon(V_\Gamma^{1+\varepsilon})$, on equal footing with the author's result that $\Gamma_0(Q)$ is generated by its elements of Frobenius norm $O_\varepsilon(Q^{1+\varepsilon})$.
notes: PDF source — stated with hedged language ('one may speculate') but refers to a precise mathematical quantity and has a non-trivial stated implication.
paper_title: Small diameters and generators for arithmetic lattices in $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{R})$ and certain Ramanujan graphs
